svg.title: Compare useful output rates with acceptance included

cc:Work.dc:title: Compare useful output rates with acceptance included
cc:Work.dc:description: The illustrative rate is s/τ before calibration overhead. Faster accepted output does not establish adequate state quality; the output error target must also be met.
